act.name: Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993
act.source_authority: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India
act.description: Central law establishing national and state human-rights commissions, inquiry powers and human-rights courts.

sections.title: Steps during and after inquiry.
sections.text: Section 18 specifies steps the Commission may take during and after a human-rights inquiry.
sections.plain_language_summary: After finding a violation, the Commission may recommend compensation or action, approach the courts, grant immediate interim relief, and provide the inquiry report.
